title: Is Proton VPN worth it? What the free plan does, what Plus adds and what it costs
seoTitle: Is Proton VPN worth it? Free vs Plus, price and renewal
description: What Proton VPN Free covers, what only Plus has, what Plus costs for the first period and at renewal, and when Proton Unlimited makes sense.
metaDescription: Is Proton VPN worth it? Free or Plus: our link offers $59.76 for 24 months, then $83.88 a year. Compare the features and terms.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Proton VPN Free covers one device without a data limit, with the app choosing the country. Plus makes sense for choosing a country, connecting up to ten devices or using NetShield. For two years, our link opens an offer below the pricing page's rate; after that, it renews annually.

contentSections.heading: What the free plan does and does not do
paragraphs: The free plan does not ask for a card. According to Proton's pages, it has no ads, no data limit and follows the policy of not keeping activity logs.

The limits are on the pricing page. The free plan connects 1 device at a time, and the page speaks of "medium VPN speed" and of servers in 10 countries, "randomly selected". The app picks the country. Ad blocking, P2P and streaming are shown as not included in the free plan, and Secure Core is marked as a premium feature.

contentSections.heading: What Plus adds
paragraphs: VPN Plus is the paid plan for the VPN alone. The pricing page lists what changes compared with the free plan.
bullets: **10 devices at the same time**, instead of 1.
**Choice of country**, among more than 140, with more than 20,000 servers.
**NetShield:** filters domains used for ads, trackers and malware while the VPN is connected and blocking is enabled.
**Secure Core:** according to Proton, routes the connection through two VPN servers, with an extra hop through protected servers operated by the company.
**P2P and streaming**, which the page lists in the plan.
postParagraphs: We do not use Proton VPN. Speed, P2P and streaming appear here as Proton advertises them, with no measurement of ours and no promise of access to any video service. The trust side, with the audits, is in [Is Proton VPN safe?](/en/reviews/is-proton-vpn-safe).

One year plus a renewal would total $119.76 for the first two years at the recorded rates; that is a calculation using today's renewal, not a guaranteed future price.

Calculated from the recorded prices, the partner offer saves $12 against the public deals page's $71.76 for the same 24 months of VPN Plus. Against the pricing page's $83.76, the difference is $24. contentSections.heading: VPN Plus or Proton Unlimited
paragraphs: Proton Unlimited brings the paid features of the VPN, the email, the cloud storage and the password manager into one account. On the same page, the 1-year plan cost $77.88 and renewed at $119.88 every 12 months.

If you subscribe to VPN Plus, you keep the free plans of the other services, and the help center says you cannot have several Plus plans on the same account. Consider Unlimited if you will also use the other services' paid features; needing two services alone does not prove it is the cheapest choice. Proton also advertises a VPN and Pass bundle, worth comparing if you need a VPN and password manager. If you only want the VPN, the 1-year Plus costs less than half in the first period ($35.88 against $77.88) and stays cheaper at renewal ($83.88 against $119.88).
We have used Proton Mail, from the same company, on the free plan for almost ten years. If the free email is enough for you, you do not need Unlimited to have the paid VPN.

contentSections.heading: What counts against it
bullets: **The equivalent monthly cost rises at renewal, which becomes annual.** The partner offer covers the first 24 months for $59.76; the advertised next charge is $83.88 every 12 months, subject to the price in force. These payments cover different periods.

**Support starts with a form.** Proton's support runs through the contact form on its site, and live chat is listed only on the paid plan. More on this in [Is Proton VPN safe?](/en/reviews/is-proton-vpn-safe).
**Our link's offer requires paying for 24 months upfront.** If you need a VPN only briefly, compare the monthly and annual outlay before committing to two years.

contentSections.heading: How to subscribe and how to back out
paragraphs: There is no coupon or code to type. The button opens the partner page, with the 2-year VPN Plus; the 1-year and monthly plans are on Proton's pricing page. The checkout shows the currency and the total before payment. Write down the renewal date on the day you buy.

According to Proton, the campaign offers are for "all new users". If you already have an account, you see its offers after signing in, and we did not read those because they require a login. If the idea is to try the free plan first, check the price in your account on the day you subscribe.

Proton's terms give a refund to those who cancel and ask for the money within 30 days of the initial purchase, once per user and only for a subscription bought directly from Proton. The steps are in [how to cancel Proton VPN and ask for a refund](/en/reviews/proton-vpn-refund-how-to-cancel).

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Is Proton VPN free? It has a free plan, with no card, and paid plans. According to Proton, the free plan has no ads and no data limit and connects 1 device at a time.
Does Proton VPN Free have a data limit? Proton says it does not. The limits of the free plan are 1 device at a time and servers in 10 countries picked by the app.

How much does Proton VPN Plus cost? In the US-dollar prices we recorded, one year cost $35.88 and our link's partner offer cost $59.76 for the first 24 months, both paid upfront. The advertised renewal was then $83.88 every 12 months; confirm currency, eligibility and the current price.

What is the difference between VPN Plus and Proton Unlimited? VPN Plus is the paid VPN alone. Unlimited also includes the paid features of the email, the cloud storage and the password manager, for a higher price.

Can I try Plus and get my money back? The terms provide for a refund within 30 days of the initial purchase, once per user, for those who subscribed directly with Proton and cancelled and asked within the period.
